742:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Tch! What are those black $$アンゲロイ$$s!?」

742:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've seen them deployed in a battle in the $$ルクバト星系$$.」

742:t_000:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As they buried the resisting enemy forces with overwhelming power, they truly looked like emissaries of God.」

742:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... They're probably forces belonging to $$サイデリアル$$'s mysterious rulers.」

742:t_000:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「They not only abandoned us, their subordinates, but sent those things to purge us!?」

742:t_000:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems the emissaries of God are appearing in many places, not just here.」

742:t_000:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Their power is overwhelming...! Every front will collapse in no time at this rate!」

742:t_000:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... either way, the universe itself won't last if the ultra-wide distortion of the dimensional boundaries continues.」

742:t_000:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...The force that seeks to vanish is beginning to concentrate in one direction...」

742:t_000:13.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It's heading to the solar system's third planet...」

747:t_000:0.en:
$$ジノ$$
「They attacked the moment we deactivated $$スヴェル$$!」

747:t_000:1.en:
$$アーニャ$$
「We'll become Earth's shield in its place.」

747:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェレミア$$
「$$アーニャ$$ is right! We must not forget that Earth is behind us!」

747:t_000:3.en:
$$藤堂$$
「But those black $$アンゲロイ$$s' power...! The $$新地球皇国$$'s units cannot compare!」

747:t_000:4.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「So these are the forces directly under the $$御使い$$s that we've heard about!」

747:t_000:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「Regroup! Don't let a single enemy unit through!」

747:t_000:6.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Roger! All units, follow me!」

747:t_000:7.en:
$$ハリー$$
「The universe's distortions and the $$御使い$$s' assault...! Humanity's future must lie beyond them!」

747:t_000:8.en:
$$マリュー$$
「We cannot lose, under any circumstances...!」

747:t_000:10.en:
$$ラクス$$
(I believe in you, $c... I believe in your victory.)

747:t_000:11.en:
$$ラクス$$
(I entrust the feelings of every living being... to you.)

752:t_1:4.en:
???
「It is between nothingness and existence... You might call it the nothingness before the beginning.」

752:t_1:7.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! How did you escape the dimensional barrier!?」

752:t_1:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「My former self would surely have been trapped in that cage and made a pathetic spectacle of himself.」

752:t_1:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I had three eternities inside me. They gave me strength.」

752:t_1:10.en:
$n
「You mean your own life... and the lives of $$アサキム$$ and $$サクリファイ$$...」

752:t_1:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Heh... You truly are brave. Even with the proof of blood carved into you, you valiantly try to face me.」

752:t_1:12.en:
$n
「I'm not the person who used to tremble in fear of the $$テンシ$$ anymore!」

752:t_1:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You all worked exactly as I planned... No, you exceeded my expectations.」

752:t_1:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And I have special feelings for you, who endured every trial I imposed.」

752:t_1:15.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... Those words of love came from my heart.」

752:t_1:16.en:
$n
「Shut up! $$アサキム$$, the people of Earth, and I aren't your property!」

752:t_1:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What do you say, $n? Would you welcome a new world alongside me?」

752:t_1:19.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The Volunteer Club, was it...? That's a wonderful thing.」

752:t_1:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That $$ウィスパード$$ girl must have foreseen this day and created the club.」

752:t_1:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You won't hesitate to throw away your life to do what you must.」

752:t_1:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You seek nothing in return, and even turn your back on love...」

752:t_1:25.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$F... I choose you to carry this world's memories into the next world.」

752:t_1:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So you reject salvation...」

752:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Don't screw with me! You killed my family! You are the one person I'll never forgive!!」

752:t_1:30.en:
$n
「If you're going to act like a god, save every human being! If you can't, do everything you can as one human being!」

752:t_1:31.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You dare lecture me, who has surpassed even the $$御使い$$s... That's why you are all so dear to me.」

752:t_1:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you chose wrongly. Instead of seeing a new world begin, you will now watch the old world die.」

752:t_1:34.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Farewell, $n. The end of myth... That is where you will all meet your end.」

752:t_1:36.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... It will become the planet of a new beginning.」

752:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What is it!? What are you trying to say!?」
